notes: Multi Trip phase 10: add the real Trip Selector workflow and a visible non-production Okinawa demo trip to validate generic renderers end-to-end. The demo uses shared Itinerary, Trip Info, Attractions, Weather, Today and Driving engines without Japan 2027 legacy scripts.
